title: I’m missing a few features
body:
I’d like to see a few more features. Overall, I’m very happy with the calendar. However, I’d like to see the following options:

1) 
To be able to get search results from more than about 1.5 years ago when I use the search function.

2)
The ability to select a specific year when viewing the calendar, so that I can, for example, find 24/12/2015 without having to scroll through months and years.

3)
The ability to add photos directly to the calendar from my phone, rather than having to save them to Google Drive first.

title: Hypocritical & Disrespectful – Bring Back International Women’s Day
body:
Google has spent years marketing itself as a company that champions diversity and inclusion, especially for women. They’ve run initiatives like ‘Women Techmakers’ and proudly advertised their efforts to support women in STEM. Yet, they’ve now erased International Women’s Day from Google Calendar—a move that directly contradicts their supposed values.

Women make up a huge part of Google’s user base and drive significant ad revenue, yet this decision shows blatant disregard not just for female users, but also for their own female employees. And considering Google is already scaling back its diversity programs, this is just another step in the wrong direction.

If Google still wants to claim it supports women, the least it can do is acknowledge a day that recognises half the world’s population. Fix this.

title: Rygte gode idéer, men mangler
body:
Appen er god og er flot designet, men der er nogle problemer med at jeg fx ikke kan vælge hvilke dage mine mål godt må ligge om morgenen og formiddag og hvilke dage de kun må ligge om aftenen (weekend og hverdag). Der er også problemer med at målene lægger sig oven i hinanden og at de ikke kan indstilles til at tage hensyn til andre begivenheder, så som, at jeg er til en forelæsning oppe på uni og så lægger den rengøring lige efter, så den ikke lægger tid af til at tage hjem.

Med de justeringer ville appen være rigtig, rigtig fin :)
